items.label: IBKR account-service outage this run: get_account_summary, get_account_balances, get_account_trades, and search_contracts all down
items.detail: Every call to get_account_summary, get_account_balances, get_account_trades, and search_contracts returned an error on every retry across 8 attempts spanning roughly 20 minutes (immediate retries, then 60s/90s/180s/240s backoff waits) between approximately 2026-09-05 04:50-05:15 UTC. get_account_positions, get_pa_performance_all_periods, get_pa_allocation, get_price_history, and whats_new all worked normally throughout (get_price_history succeeded on the first attempt for all 12 tickers used below), so this is a partial outage of specific account-service endpoints, not a full connector failure. Consequences for this run: NAV/cash had to be derived indirectly rather than read directly from get_account_summary (see the reconciliation item below); margin/leverage could not be checked at all; get_account_trades could not confirm or deny new trade activity for track-record.json (every position's share count today matches yesterday's run exactly, which is suggestive of no new trades but not conclusive); and search_contracts could not resolve contract_ids for the hedge-candidate ETFs (SHY/IEF/TLT/AGG/EFA/VWO/DBC), so hedge_analysis and diversification_actions below carry forward the 2026-09-04 run's correlation numbers unchanged rather than being recomputed today.
items.recommendation: No portfolio action needed here -- this is a data-availability issue, not a market risk. Re-run the risk review once get_account_summary/get_account_balances/get_account_trades/search_contracts are confirmed healthy to get a fully live NAV/margin check and fresh hedge-candidate correlations; until then, treat this run's leverage/margin status as unconfirmed rather than assumed safe.

items.label: SPY5 + SPYL (S&P 500 duplication)
items.detail: SPY5 (288 sh, $221,961.60, live get_account_positions) and SPYL (6,240 sh, $119,046.71) both track the S&P 500 and together total $341,008.32 = 69.54% of this run's estimated NAV ($490,352.61 -- see reconciliation item below for how NAV was derived while get_account_summary is down). Fresh 1-year daily-return correlation (n=251 aligned trading days, 2025-09-08 to 2026-09-04, live get_price_history via a background subagent using the account's own contract_ids, so search_contracts was not needed for this pair) is +0.9931 -- unchanged to 4 decimal places from the 2026-09-04 run -- effectively one position split across two tickers.
items.recommendation: Trim SPYL (the smaller, more redundant leg) by roughly a third (~2,080 shares, ~$39,690 at today's $19.08) and redeploy into DBC (Invesco DB Commodity Index): DBC was the best of 7 hedge candidates tested against the SPY5+SPYL blend in the 2026-09-04 run (correlation -0.2422) -- NOT recomputed today since search_contracts (needed to resolve DBC's contract_id) is down. Treat this as directionally reliable but re-verify the correlation once the connector recovers before executing a large trim.

items.label: Precious-metals / mining cluster (IGLN, SSLV, KGC, NEM) -- fresh internal correlation is the tightest of any cluster in the account
items.detail: IGLN ($40,218.04, 8.20% of est. NAV), SSLV ($7,432.82, 1.52%), KGC ($8,489.25, 1.73%) and NEM ($6,020.23, 1.23%) total $62,160.34 = 12.68% of NAV (live get_account_positions). This run computed the cluster's own internal pairwise correlations for the first time (previous runs only tested its blended correlation against hedge candidates): 1-year daily returns (n=247, 2025-09-05 to 2026-09-04, live get_price_history) show IGLN/SSLV +0.8165, IGLN/KGC +0.6924, IGLN/NEM +0.6805, SSLV/KGC +0.6464, SSLV/NEM +0.6253, KGC/NEM +0.8885 -- average pairwise +0.7249, the tightest internal cohesion of any multi-ticker cluster in the account this run (vs. materials satellites' +0.4872 and the AI/tech cluster's +0.2638, both also refreshed today). All four names moved together today too: IGLN -$576.74, KGC -$198.00, SSLV -$128.62, NEM -$109.98, a combined -$1,013.34 single-day move in the same direction. Upgraded to HIGH from MED on this fresh evidence.
items.recommendation: Add TLT (iShares 20+ Year Treasury) as the cluster hedge: TLT was the best of 7 candidates tested against this blend in the 2026-09-04 run (correlation +0.0914) -- not recomputed today because search_contracts is down, so re-verify before sizing. Size at roughly 15-20% of the cluster's value (~$9,320-$12,430 at today's live cluster value).

items.label: Zero fixed-income ballast ahead of a live-repricing September FOMC
items.detail: get_pa_allocation (dated 2026-09-03, the most recent successful pull -- get_account_summary/balances are down this run, see outage item above) shows 0% of NAV in bonds by ASSET_CLASS; live get_account_positions confirms no bond ETF is held. September 16 FOMC hike-odds readings diverge by source this week: Forbes cited CME FedWatch at 66% on Aug 31 and a separate source cited 70.2% 'a few days ago,' while CNBC described the decision as 'now a coin flip' after Fed Chair Warsh's Aug 28 remarks, and another read on Sept 3 put it at 53% -- the spread itself (53-70%) reflects real, unresolved uncertainty into the Sept 15-16 meeting, on top of the Iran conflict adding a second live inflation/rate wildcard (below).
items.recommendation: Establish a Treasury ballast sized at roughly 5% of NAV (~$24,500) in SHY (1-3Y): SHY showed the lowest correlation to the SPY5+SPYL blend of any low-volatility candidate tested in the 2026-09-04 run (+0.0061 of 7) -- not recomputed today, re-verify once search_contracts recovers before establishing the position.

items.label: Iran conflict escalates further -- US strikes on Iranian air-defense/radar/maritime sites, controversial wedding strike, Strait of Hormuz blockade at 87 vessels
items.detail: US Central Command struck Iranian air-defense sites, radar systems and maritime assets on Sept 2, in retaliation for Iran attempting to lay new sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz and for an earlier Iranian strike on a US base in Jordan (source: NPR, 'U.S. military strikes Iran, while Trump vows more for Tehran's retaliation,' Sept 2, 2026). One US strike reportedly hit a home hosting a wedding, killing 5 and wounding dozens -- VP Vance said he is 'extremely skeptical' of the reports. CENTCOM's Strait of Hormuz blockade count reached 87 vessels, and Trump called the war 'small potatoes' for the US on Sept 4 (source: ABC News live updates, accessed 2026-09-05). The account holds no pure-play oil & gas exposure (CCJ is a uranium miner, not oil & gas), so direct hit is limited, but a broad equity selloff or an inflation surprise complicating the Sept 16 Fed decision either way would still pressure SPY5/SPYL (69.54% of NAV).
items.recommendation: No new energy-specific position -- the DBC hedges recommended above already carry meaningful commodity/energy exposure and would partially cushion an oil/inflation-driven shock. Given the magnitude of this week's escalation (wedding-strike controversy, 87-vessel blockade) and this run's inability to confirm live cash/margin (outage above), hold off on new discretionary purchases until both the IBKR connector and the acute escalation risk clarify.

items.label: NAV derivation and cross-validation while get_account_summary/get_account_balances are down
items.detail: With get_account_summary/get_account_balances unavailable, this run derived NAV two independent ways and cross-checked them: (1) live get_account_positions position sum ($480,836.22) + cash carried forward from the 2026-09-03 get_pa_allocation pull ($9,516.40, ESTIMATED) = $490,352.61; (2) the 2026-09-03 get_pa_allocation/get_pa_performance NAV ($492,564.16) plus today's aggregate live position daily_pnl (-$2,210.22, summed from get_account_positions) = $490,353.94. The two estimates agree to within $1.32 (0.0003%), giving good confidence that get_account_positions reflects Friday 2026-09-04's close (one session ahead of the account-summary/allocation pipeline, which appears stuck at Thursday 2026-09-03 -- consistent with the broader outage above), and that $490,352.61 is a reasonable current NAV estimate. This run's portfolio_snapshot uses that estimate, dated 2026-09-04.
items.recommendation: None needed for the portfolio itself -- this is a data-methodology note. Confirm this estimate against a live get_account_summary figure once the connector recovers.
